description: Defines the HtmlDumper class for rendering profiling profiles as HTML output within the Twig templating engine, specifically in the Profile dumper subsystem.

classes.name: HtmlDumper
classes.description: A final class extending BaseDumper that formats profiling data into styled HTML output.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Converts a Profile object into an HTML string wrapped in <pre> tags.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats template profile entries with background color styling.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats non-template profile entries with styling indicating type.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats timing information with color coding based on duration percentage.
